data.usage_sampling: mean 12 events per account-month (sampled, see generate_data.py --usage-mean)
data.note: Repo data is a sample, NOT 7M usage events. Generator can scale locally with --usage-mean / --accounts.

retention_metrics.definition: Monthly NRR=(starting-churned-contraction+expansion)/starting; GRR=(starting-churned-contraction)/starting; logo churn=churned accounts/starting accounts, per month, defined once in dbt/models/marts/retention_metrics.sql. Logo churn here is MONTHLY, not annual.

tests.runner: DuckDB (dbt not installed locally; dbt SQL files provided, runner strips Jinja and executes same logic)

note_on_benchmark: Runtimes are median ms over 7 runs per query on this machine/data size (in-memory DuckDB, 132,952 usage events). They vary by machine and load; rerun src/benchmark.py to reproduce on your machine. Do not compare these ms figures to a different dataset size.
